title: Reading Settings
content:
**Version Selection**

You can switch between different versions of the work using the version controls:

**AI (EN)** provides the primary English reading experience and is the recommended version for most readers.

**Human Draft (Traditional Chinese)** presents the original prompt-based story script with instruction-related content removed. Readers who can read Traditional Chinese are also welcome to experience this version.

**Human Prompt (Traditional Chinese)** presents the original prompt, including its instruction-related content. This version is intended for readers who are interested in seeing the source material and AI generation process.

**A + H + P** displays all available versions together when no individual version is selected.

※ Published works still receive final human editing and may therefore differ slightly from the original source material.

---

**Upper-Left Controls**

**Dark Mode** allows you to switch the article text area between a light and dark reading appearance for greater reading comfort.

*Only applies to article text.*

It affects only the article text area, not the rest of the website.

**Reading Font** allows you to adjust the font, font size, and line spacing used for English and Chinese article text.

---

**Lower Controls**

**Favorite** adds or removes the current article from your favorites. Favorited articles are displayed at the top of the Codex list.

**Clear Reading Progress** removes the saved reading progress for the current article.

**Save Reading Progress** updates the saved reading position for the current article.

Please note that reading progress is saved separately for each version: **AI, Human Draft, Human Prompt, and A + H + P.**

**Read Done** adds or removes the Read Done status for the current article. Completed articles can be easily identified for later review and will also display a special marker in the Codex list.

**Immersion Mode** hides the interface and provides a more spacious and comfortable reading area.
